title: Curve-preserving ExtrudeMeshNode with generated output
description: When input has bezier handles, produce top face with copied handles (translation preserves tangent shape); side walls have zero handles on vertical edges. Add 'generated' BOOLEAN output port - true on top faces, false on side walls. Fallback to current straight behavior when no handles present.
definition-of-done: 1. Extrude with handles produces valid handle arrays on output mesh. 2. generated output port marks top faces. 3. Fallback works for non-coons workflows. 4. region=true mode handles bookkeeping correctly.
testing-plan: 1. cube->assign_bezier_handles->extrude_mesh(top)->coons_patch produces watertight mesh with smooth extrusion boundary (no cheese grater). 2. Chain: inset_faces with selection=extrude.generated targets top face correctly.
